decisions: Prioritize remediation in the order 3, 4, 1, 2.
Implement issue 5 coverage alongside the individual fixes rather than treating it as a standalone defect.
evidence: GitHub inventory found five open unlabeled issues and no closed issues.

Issue 2 returns static catalog candidates without checking local availability and reproduces irrelevant results for a drum intent.

Acceptance criteria coverage: AC1 pass, AC2 pass, AC3 pass, AC4 pass, AC5 pass in local deterministic API/contract fixtures; opt-in Live execution deferred to user.

phaseOutput.handoff: Consumed context files: AGENTS.md, task context, installed Remote Script, repository Remote Script, MCP schemas, active bridge responses, and official Live Object Model documentation. phaseOutput.notes:
Acceptance criteria coverage: AC1 pass, AC2 pass, AC3 pass.
Test plan: call only GET /status, GET /project, and GET /devices/parameters for every track, return, and master chain; compare active responses with installed and repository source; perform no writes.
Results: active bridge reachable at 127.0.0.1:9789; Set has 7 tracks, 2 returns, master, and 28 devices. Gateway exposes 14 parameters in each instance; ValhallaSupermassive 19; TDR Kotelnikov 22; ParametricOD 7; SSD5, Ample Bass, and Youlean only Device On; TDR Nova exposes one or two controls depending on the instance.
Evidence: four Orchestra artifacts record active responses, per-device counts, installed hashes, and source diagnosis.
Source comparison: live_devices.py serializes every object in device.parameters; live_summaries.py emits only name, value, min, max, and isEnabled. Installed files match repository SHA-1 values, so stale installation is excluded.
Classification: missing entire controls are a Live/plugin exposure limitation because the documented Live Object Model only makes automatable Device.parameters accessible; missing display strings, quantization, enum values, original names, defaults, automation state, and activity state are a Remote Script serialization limitation; MCP schema accepts numeric reads/writes and is not dropping listed parameters.
Recommendation: first enrich parameter_summary with displayValue, isQuantized, valueItems, originalName, defaultValue, automationState, and state. For SSD5/Ample/Youlean/Nova, configure desired controls in Live plugin Configure mode or map them to Rack macros; the documented LOM has no API to force arbitrary hidden plugin controls into device.parameters.
No repository files changed and no active Set mutation occurred.
phaseOutput.summary: Read-only audit of the active Ableton Set confirms broad parameter access for Gateway, Valhalla, and Kotelnikov but Live-level exposure limits for SSD5, Ample Bass, Youlean, and TDR Nova.
